presentationRules.backgroundFit: centered cover over continuous whole application surface
presentationRules.nestedCards: transparent within the outer glass surface
presentationRules.gradients: Default export omits gradient tokens unless explicitly authored; these fallback values add no gradient by themselves.
presentationRules.protectedChrome: Native command/status/policy/recovery surfaces remain outside theme layout/CSS authority. Browser chrome is a synthetic visual representation only.

limitations: Proposal for a new immutable contract revision; existing r4 schemas and accepted fixtures are unchanged.
No theme import, media decode, CSS/layout runtime or release activation is authorized by this proposal.
Per-widget style roles and actual DOM results still require Design review.
